title: Galaxy Withdraws Call That Bitcoin’s Bear Market Ended in June
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Galaxy Withdraws Call That Bitcoin’s Bear Market Ended in June Galaxy Research withdrew its October call that bitcoin's bear market ended in June and said a daily close below $58,525 would signal a move to a materially lower low. This post Galaxy Withdraws Call That Bitcoin’s Bear Market Ended in June first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
